NAME
       diagnose-conn - Diagnoses network connection problems.

MODULE
       wom

SYNTAX
       run diagnose-conn

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the diagnose-conn component within the wom module to display diagnostic information about network connections.

SEE ALSO
       run, tmsh, wom verify-config
